name: Paris Verona
source:
A candidate to become [url=/c12544]Juliet's[/url] fiancee and a vampire hunter.
He's the nephew of [url=/c12551]Archduke Verona[/url], and the future successor of that position.
He has great ability as a hunter, but also a calm and graceful demeanor that makes him quite popular. He's a young noble with no faults.
